defs.def: a section of a large organization such as a government, business, university, etc. 部；司；局；处；系；（医院的）科；部门

ex.s: The Parks Department is not oblivious to the issue.
ex.t: 公园管理局并非对此视而不见。

ex.s: “We didn’t make a big deal of that,” said Novem Auyeung, a Parks Department senior scientist.
ex.t: “我们没把那当作什么大事，”公园管理局高级科学家诺韦姆·奥扬说。

ex.s: “We’re not going to go cutting down any big old oaks,” and neither will the department completely stop planting new ones, said Auyeung.
ex.t: “我们不会去砍任何高大的老橡树，”部门也不会完全停止种植新树，奥扬说。

ex.s: In 1941, Dr Lin became the first Chinese woman ever to be appointed director of the OB-GYN department of the PUMC Hospital, but just a few months later, the department was closed because of the war.
ex.t: 1941年，林医生成为协和医院妇产科首位被任命为主任的中国女性，但仅几个月后，该科室因战争关闭。
